name: Eglin AFB
description: Eglin AFB is home to the 96th Test Wing and is the largest Air Force base by land area. Major testing and training installation supporting conventional weapons development and F-35 training.

currentNotifications.body: Increased activity on the Eglin range may cause noise in surrounding communities.

events.title: My Mini & Me Dance Class
events.address: Youth Center, Building 2582, Eglin Air Force Base, FL, 32542-0000
events.description: Join the Eglin Youth Center on Tuesdays from 12 to 1 p.m. beginning September 1, 2026 for a special dance program perfect for parents and their littles! Can your “mini” walk? Then this class is for them! And YOU! Jazz, tap, ballet, and creative movement with your mini. Bond through movement and music while creating memories with your young ones. Plus a healthy activity! The cost is $80 per month per child w/ adult. Open to children ages 0 through 2! (As long as they can walk! And boogie!) Event Calendar: https://eglin96fss.com/series/mini-me-dance-classes/

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Dormitory Management (850-882-5218) for unaccompanied housing or Eglin Inn (850-882-3311) for temporary lodging. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 96 FSS, M&FRC, and official Eglin sites for in-processing and community support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
